I prefer practical stuff like computer science and economics where numbers make sense in real life. It's not that I hate it, but the abstract nature of pure math just doesn't click for me.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Whenever someone brings up complex formulas or advanced calculus, my stomach turns. I worry about looking stupid if I can't follow along. It's not that I'm incapable, but the pressure makes me freeze up and avoid topics that feel too theoretical.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor app a few months ago. Honestly, it helped break down problems into smaller steps which I could actually understand. It didn't overwhelm me with jargon like traditional textbooks did. I'd say it was a game-changer for my confidence.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves standardizing your data first, then finding eigenvectors of the covariance matrix that capture most variance. Keep components explaining significant variance. Don't worry too much about the heavy math if you use tools like Python or R libraries—they handle the complex calculations for you.
